value.summary: A muddy Button Hills sheep village of low stone cottages, stubborn families, and children who gather old coat buttons after rain. Years ago, rumours about an uncanny infant brought passing Tensor monks to its lanes.

The Tensor Sect’s headmaster and strongest living fighter. Orun Vale trains with unnerving patience and taught Ganji directly from childhood; his affection for the escaped young monk is sincere, but tangled with the belief that Ganji’s future belongs to the sect.

value.summary: Nettle is a soot-grey tom with one white toe who understands Ganji’s words and mood but obeys no one. He has followed Ganji into Bramblebridge after two weeks on the road, steals food when useful, and may offer clues through stubbornly feline choices. He has no combat statistics, player control, or required plot role.

value.summary: Ganji was born in Merebutton to a human father and elven mother. His parents abandoned him as an infant after village rumours made his slight catlike features an attraction for passing travellers. Tensor monks came to investigate the rumours and took him to Highmead as a possible prophecy. Ganji knows neither parent nor their reasons, and assumes they were cruel; the deeper truth is optional background, not his central purpose.
